input: Start a daily gratitude log in a small notebook

gold.taskTitle: Start a Daily Gratitude Log in a Small Notebook
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to begin a consistent daily habit of writing a gratitude log by hand in a small notebook.

questions.title: Do you already own a notebook for this?
questions.description: Find out if the user has a notebook ready or needs to get one first.

questions.title: What time of day will you write in it?
questions.description: Identify the preferred daily time slot, such as morning, evening, or before bed.

questions.title: How many gratitude entries will you write per day?
questions.description: Clarify whether the user wants one entry, three bullet points, a full paragraph, or another format.

questions.title: Do you want a prompt to guide each entry?
questions.description: Determine if the user wants a guiding question or structure per entry, or prefers freewriting.

questions.title: Where will the notebook live so you see it daily?
questions.description: Establish a physical location, such as a bedside table or desk, to anchor the habit.

questions.title: What reminder or trigger will cue you to write?
questions.description: Identify whether the user wants a phone alarm, a habit stack, or another cue to stay consistent.

questions.title: How long do you want to sustain this habit initially?
questions.description: Set a target duration or milestone, such as 7 days, 30 days, or ongoing, to define early success.
